en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a rural house with decorative wooden porch details, set in a large grassy yard lined with young trees whose trunks are painted white. In the foreground stand two small children in light-colored dresses, holding hands and facing the camera. Another person stands near the house in the background. At the upper left, printed text reads "Fra Finstad, Hernes." The scene suggests a family farm or homestead in a Nordic countryside.
